searchText: Was there a specific reason for 2537 being bumped from Cancun? It was always the second most popular in all votes. Hi everyone, is there a devp2p specialist or someone who knows devp2p well and can check something with me quickly ? https://dontasktoask.com/ Too many things in the fork already 😅 Not asking directly because its security related ! You should reach out to the official security people then. Good chance a scammer/hacker will DM you saying "I know devp2p and can help". https://ethereum.org/en/bug-bounty/ Yes but before i just wanted to see something with someone who is working/know devp2p well before reporting anything If you know someone tell me then i'll reach out to him. I know that felix can help with devp2p stuff but he's not available. ACDC in 35 minutes https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/854 https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91725886939?pwd=b2kzT0JGeFAzTmhyb1BYSTgrZ0xwdz09 call now Thanks again <@478543974156730369> and Csaba for presenting today on the analysis of the large mainnet blocks Slides for reference: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1glx__evliifIRyS3GnbzADd0rVPV4CFPh92INEsRdX8
